## Scope and spec
- Task ID / scoped Spec Kit:
- Exact baseline SHA and implementation SHA:
- Goal, dependencies, exclusions:
- Given / When / Then acceptance criteria agreed before implementation:

## Evidence (required; mark unavailable, never invent)
- [ ] Persisted implementation and reproducible build
- [ ] Positive, negative, boundary, failure/recovery and regression results
- [ ] Tenant isolation / role denial tests (or explained non-applicability)
- [ ] Real API + database + browser/agent E2E (not mock-only)
- [ ] Screenshot from running browser for each UI screen, viewport/SHA and source environment
- [ ] Restart, deployment, rollback and observability validation (or scoped exclusion)
- [ ] Linked immutable logs/artifacts and test commands
- [ ] Acceptance ledger updated; no unsubstantiated ACCEPTED
- [ ] Independent human reviewer checked exact SHA/environment

## Acceptance
- Status: NOT_STARTED / IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED / READY_FOR_REVIEW / REJECTED / ACCEPTED
- Level: L0 / L1 / L2 / L3 / L4 / L5
- Outstanding prerequisites:
- Owner:
- Independent reviewer decision and evidence link:

CI green alone does not equal feature acceptance. Production requires L5 plus separate production-readiness gates.
